entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Gheorghe Alexianu was a Romanian lawyer, high school teacher and associate professor who served as governor of Transnistria between 1941 and 1944. In 1946, he was accused and convicted of war crimes, crimes against peace and crimes against humanity; he was sentenced to death by the Bucharest People's Tribunal, and was executed by firing squad on June 1, 1946.
